notes.title: Achievement Bug Fixed
notes.content:
There was a bug that did not allow unlocking the achievement, now the problem has been solved and you can unlock the achievement!
In addition, 2 New buttons have been added to the main menu.

Have Fun!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30000776/69e9094f149624141210eba86d40cd54d256a2a3.png[/img]

notes.title: Bug Fixes
notes.content:
In this update we solved some major and minor bugs.
Thanks to all the posts on the Steam Community Hub who told us the bugs to fix!

Also we updated the images of the library.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30000776/e41e8abc74a749f85c53e7f7ab52d179fc7f992a.png[/img]

notes.title: Winners
notes.content:
137 users participated in the competition and now here you are the winners:
The first place is won by Kageyasu, from Japan
The second place is won by Chojiro, from Japan
And the third place is won by Valtin, from Germany
Winners have already been contacted in their e-mail.
Thank you all!
